results.title: Mali’s military and armed groups committing abuses against civilians: HRW | Conflict News | Al Jazeera
results.snippet:
Mali’s military and its Russian paramilitary allies have killed civilians in breach of international law, and opposition armed groups have done likewise, Human Rights Watch (HRW) says.

Soldiers and fighters “are committing grave laws-of-war violations while international organisations and governments largely stand by”, the United States-based rights watchdog said in a report released on Monday.
